bootstrap.method: percentile; works resampled with replacement on each fixed graph and tree, the same resamples for every row of a universe and every condition (paired)

runtime.machine: 16 CPUs, 30 GiB RAM, no swap; memory budget for this run ~12 GiB
runtime.scheme_builds: about 1 min for 13 schemes; every file sha256 equal to 2026-10-10
runtime.placements_and_gold: 1270 s for run_benchmark.py --jobs 2 (19 placed jobs, 5 gold, 1 skipped); all 24 cost_norm equal to the published 2026-10-10/r2/r3 values. Peak RSS not sampled; the largest process seen was the lcc-full shelfmark store at 0.67 GiB
runtime.embed_minilm: corpus 191 s, peak RSS 1.23 GiB; holdout 1 s, 0.27 GiB (6 threads, batch 64). Rebuilds the committed MiniLM k10 graphs byte for byte
runtime.embed_bge_small: corpus 851 s (sharing CPUs with placements), peak RSS 2.37 GiB; holdout 2 s, 0.31 GiB (6 threads, batch 64). Rebuilds the committed bge-small k20 graphs byte for byte
runtime.embed_nomic: max 512 tokens, batch 16, 6 threads, vectors streamed to a memmap: corpus 2687 s, peak RSS 4.23 GiB (4.34 GiB sampled with ps); holdout 7 s, 1.06 GiB. The earlier attempt (model's 8192-token limit, batch 64, vectors held in memory) was killed at 16 GiB
runtime.graphs_from_vectors: k10/k50 from stored vectors: under 0.4 GiB and a few seconds each
runtime.learned_cache: learned_benchmark.py 94 s, sampled peak 0.39 GiB; 24 of 25 runs equal 2026-10-10-learned (test-msc-gold differs, see notes)
runtime.refits: bge-small and nomic full fit, holdout insertion, 80/20 split fit and insertion: 20 s
runtime.scoring: 468 runs + 27 references, 2 concurrent jobs, 1000 bootstrap resamples each: 446 s, sampled peak RSS 0.40 GiB (driver plus both harness processes). A first pass (539 s) was discarded: its skill intervals used the wrong reference replicates (fixed in crates/bench/src/main.rs); its point values were identical
